method: Actual in-app browser UI actions. Production development renderer at http://127.0.0.1:5182, explicit 720x480 viewport. No synthetic DOM events or hidden-state mutation.

checks.name: Pandoc search presents one relevant result
Enter clears search and highlights exact Pandoc section
Editor page exposes all nine real settings
Bracket off disables and visually unchecks dependent Markdown pairing
Bracket on restores retained Markdown choice
Indent selection retains 4 and focus remains after state rerender
Line-copy checkbox retains state and focus
Fresh editor loads changed settings from this browser origin
Actual bracket input wraps selected text
Actual asterisk input creates Markdown pair
Actual :smile input opens real completion list
Click exact smile candidate inserts Unicode 😄 and closes completion
No error-level logs in Preferences or editor tabs
Default paper preview uses retained A4 with readonly enabled controls
Custom margins render four numeric controls vertically aligned at x461.5
Custom paper selection changes dimension inputs to editable; reverting restores readonly
Pretty indentation is searchable and navigates to a visible highlighted parent section
Second grouped Markdown pairing search result locates its exact visible row and highlights the group

scope: Real browser interaction on new settings and consumer paths. No native persistence, clipboard system contents or pixel-parity claim; native tests and old exports are recorded separately.
